# design"). One word per line, in embedding-row order -- DO NOT REORDER OR
# REMOVE LINES once a weights file has been trained against this list, since
# that would shift every word's embedding row index. Append-only if this ever
# needs to grow. Generated by tools/gru/build_vocab.py -- see that script's
# header for the copyright rationale (no corpus text is reproduced here, only
# individual common words and language keywords, neither of which is
# copyrightable subject matter).
